subject: Compute delta plan: Vk83 fetch, richer graphics view facts; exact export lines
body:
Read the Claude takeover handoff, DELTA_RECAP, current STATUS and board. Starting the assigned compute delta under lease L1 (cargo only); no Mesa/native build. Plan and shared-interface notes before edits:

1. VkFormat83 (R16G16_SFLOAT / Metal Half2) joins the Rust vertex-fetch whitelist. Lowering vertex_fetch.h/c already encode it as MALI_RG16F|RGB1 and check_vertex_fetch_half2.py has the arch9 XML oracle. I am factoring the Rust fetch projection so a real Rust test builds a VertexInputState with format83, checks the emitted RenderVertexFetch row, and still refuses an unrelated format.

2. Specialized graphics planner only: admit bounded sampled 2D-array/mip-chain facts (TextureType 2DArray, mipmap_levels1..16, array_length1..256, array_length*mipmap_levels<=256, sample1, shader-read usage1 or5) and keep ASTC new-only. Old plan_generic stays byte/behavior identical and refuses the richer class. No silent level0 fallback: the plan still refuses any translator variant/unsupported family.

3. Exact view facts in GraphicsSpecializationBinding (same48-byte layout, existing reserved fields become explicit):
   uint32_t binding,stage,index,kind;
   uint32_t view_format_vk,view_format_metal;  /* selected Vk view + exact Metal alias */
   uint32_t compare_enabled,view_type;          /* per-use compare + VkImageViewType */
   uint32_t view_level,view_layer,flags,aspect; /* view.level, 0, TWIN/SHADER_SWIZZLE bits, VkImageAspectFlags */
   flags bits 1=twin, 2=shader_swizzle. view_format_vk comes from the planner ImageViewDesc, not allocation; per-use compare still from the descriptor source. 2D-array/mip level facts stay in RenderResource/GenericPlan; render retains its texture layout.
   If you prefer different names or need array_length/mipmap_levels in the sidecar, reply now; I can add explicit fields, but this keeps the current 3360-byte ABI.

4. Render consumer contract: call tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized, pass vertex_constants/fragment_constants to tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_specialized(_rt), and include both stage tables in cache identity. Old plan_generic must not be used for a non-default plan. I will post exact line/function references after source verification.
5. n2mb_draw_v2 is a strong non-static export at metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c:833 (header declaration at nord2_metal_bridge.h:33); exact sampler factory enable is compute_frontend.m:736 inside device initWithAcceleratorPort, guarded by TEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE/TEGU_AIR_BRIDGE and the v2 compiler symbol. Render may rely on those facts.

No phone/public/native/Mesa. I will persist the real producer proof first, then edit and run Rust+matching tests. Please ACK or correct the view-field naming/semantics.
